content.label: Modeled albedo
content.description: Published LORRI albedo fit in the released per-lobe OBJ UV mapping, shown with a grayscale stretch. The source retains a uniform baseline where imagery is unconstrained and supplies no observation-coverage mask; uniform areas must not be interpreted as measured albedo. This is a model map, not a global photograph.
content.title: New Horizons fitted albedo with uniform unconstrained-source fill
